ctx.x: You and Al McKibbon were in quite a few bands together, weren't you?

Dizzy and J.C. Heard. He's with Sammy Davis now. I called J.C. about two or three months ago and he said he's been with Sammy Davis for five years, so that means he's workin' steady. (laughter) Sammy works all the time.

One of the things I was curious about, in talking about the domestic scene, is interests that you had outside of music and things that you would do when you weren't working, given that you worked at the Paradise...
